normative_extracts.quote: The small viewport-percentage units (sv*) reflect the viewport size when all dynamic UA interfaces are expanded; large (lv*) when retracted; dynamic (dv*) tracks the current state.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: 100vh maps to the Large Viewport (lvh); 100svh locks to the Small Viewport; 100dvh triggers layout recalculation when toolbars animate.

production_failures.symptom: Bottom CTA button in a 100vh mobile hero is hidden behind the Safari/Chrome address bar
production_failures.root_cause: Legacy 100vh equals 100lvh (toolbars retracted), which is taller than the visible screen on initial load.
production_failures.mitigation: Use min-height: 100svh (or 100dvh) so the entire hero fits inside the visible viewport.

production_failures.symptom: Page content stutters or shifts vertically as mobile toolbars collapse during scroll
production_failures.root_cause: Using 100dvh on multiple stacked sections forces Layout recalculations as the toolbar animates.
production_failures.mitigation: Use 100svh for static full-height sections that should stay rock-solid during scroll.
